summary: Reproduced DeepSeek-V4 DSML direct-JSON tool arguments being forwarded with model-added arguments/args envelopes. Added schema-aware normalization for complete V4 arguments, including JSON-string and repeated envelopes, while preserving legitimate schema properties and unknown/corrupted payloads. Direct-JSON streaming is held until the invoke closes so emitted fragments remain consistent with normalization.

tests.what_was_measured: Before change: 6 existing tests passed. After change: 10 tests and 6 subtests passed, including reported envelope forms plus independent schema-ambiguity and corruption boundaries.
253 DeepSeek/function-call parser tests and 10 subtests passed, covering non-streaming and token-chunked streaming behavior.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ca23cd208fff/venv/bin/python reports/j-ca23cd208fff/raw reproduction scripts (captured in reproduction-before.txt and reproduction-after.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: Actual DeepSeekV4Detector output: four reported envelope variants were nested before the fix and normalize to the declared command/flag payload after it; valid, legitimate arguments-property, unknown-key, and corrupted-string cases remain unchanged.

remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp weights were available, so the model's generation frequency, semantic tool choice, vision architecture, and retry behavior were not reproduced end to end.
The qualified tiny Llama serving fixture cannot validate DeepSeek-V4 output behavior and was therefore not used as substitute evidence.
Mid-stream corruption inside the command text is not safely recoverable and is intentionally forwarded unchanged.
Envelope repair requires a declared top-level property set and a candidate whose keys fit it; ambiguous schemas and legitimate parameters named arguments or args are intentionally preserved.
